quote.text: You don't get paid for the leads you generate. You get paid for the ones you close.
quote.author: Alex Hormozi

schedule: No calls scheduled — check Calendly for any new bookings.
focus: Zero prospect replies in the last 48 hours and still 0 closed from 27+ leads. Run a follow-up blitz today: call or text every unbooked lead in GHL with a direct booking link. Sunday afternoon is prime time to catch home service owners off the job — and every cold day costs you another $35 in ad spend chasing new leads instead of closing bought ones.

Good news: your GHL trial extension was granted — you now have until June 26, 19 days. Your extension request said you're 'currently having trouble' with it. Write down exactly what's broken in GHL and fix it this week — the pipeline and all 27+ leads live there, and the deadline only moved, it didn't disappear.
